description: UNOSAT and partner damage assessments: Yemen is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite-detected damage and destruction in the city of Sana'a, Sana'a Governorate, Yemen. Using satellite imagery acquired 15 May 2015, 12 and 31 December 2014, UNITAR-UNOSAT identified a total of 440 affected structures. Approximately 74 of these structures were destroyed, 106 severely damaged, and 260 moderately damaged. Additionally, 35 impact craters were found. Coverage: Yemen. The portal lists 8 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are complex emergency-conflict-security, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2017-03-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency shelter and critical facility planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
